funFact: Werewolves transform at full moon
description: The werewolf is a human cursed to become a wolf under the full moon.

name: Yeti
funFact: Yeti footprints can be 45 cm long
description: The Yeti, or Abominable Snowman, is a giant ape-like cryptid of the Himalayas.

name: Goblin
funFact: Goblins were master miners and craftsmen
description: Goblins are small, clever, green-skinned tricksters living in caves and mines.

name: Troll
funFact: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight
description: Trolls are giant, slow-witted brutes who live under bridges and mountains.

name: Roc
funFact: Roc eggs were said to be 15 meters around
description: The Roc is a gigantic bird of Arabian myth so large it can carry elephants.

name: Sphinx
funFact: The Sphinx asked riddles to travelers
description: The Sphinx has a lion's body, human head and eagle wings, guardian of riddles.

name: Chimera
funFact: Chimera had a lion head, goat body and snake tail
description: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent from Greek myth.

name: Siren
funFact: Sirens lured sailors to shipwreck with songs
description: Sirens are enchanting half-bird, half-women whose songs doom sailors.

name: Harpy
funFact: Harpies were winds spirits that snatched souls
description: The Harpy is half-woman, half-bird, a swift wind spirit that steals offerings.

name: Garuda
funFact: Garuda is the king of birds in Hindu myth
description: Garuda is a giant eagle-like deity, mount of Vishnu and enemy of serpents.

name: Qilin
funFact: Qilin appears only during peaceful reigns
description: The Qilin is a gentle Chinese unicorn-deer with dragon scales that brings good fortune.

name: Fenrir
funFact: Fenrir was chained by the gods with magic ribbon
description: Fenrir is the monstrous wolf of Norse myth destined to devour Odin at Ragnarok.

name: Jörmungandr
funFact: Jörmungandr encircles the entire world
description: Jörmungandr is the World Serpent of Norse myth, so huge it bites its own tail around Earth.

name: Cyclops
funFact: Cyclops forged Zeus's thunderbolts
description: The Cyclops is a one-eyed giant blacksmith of Greek myth who forged divine weapons.

name: Medusa
funFact: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone
description: Medusa is a Gorgon with snakes for hair whose gaze petrifies victims.

name: Anubis
funFact: Anubis weighed hearts against a feather
description: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god who guides souls to the afterlife.

name: Allosaurus
funFact: Allosaurus had 32 teeth shaped like steak knives
description: Allosaurus was the top predator of Jurassic North America before T. rex.

name: Spinosaurus
funFact: Spinosaurus had a sail 1.8m tall on its back
description: Spinosaurus was a semi-aquatic fish-eating dinosaur larger than T. rex with a distinctive sail.

name: Diplodocus
funFact: Diplodocus had a tail with 80 vertebrae
description: Diplodocus was an extremely long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail.

name: Parasaurolophus
funFact: Its crest acted like a trumpet
description: Parasaurolophus was a crested hadrosaur that could make loud calls through its hollow crest.

name: Iguanodon
funFact: Iguanodon had thumb spikes for defense
description: Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs discovered, with distinctive thumb spikes.

name: Archaeopteryx
funFact: Archaeopteryx is the earliest known bird
description: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur-bird that could glide between trees 150 million years ago.

name: Mosasaurus
funFact: Mosasaurus had double-hinged jaws like a snake
description: Mosasaurus was a giant marine reptile that ruled Late Cretaceous seas.

name: Plesiosaurus
funFact: Plesiosaurus had four flippers and a long neck
description: Plesiosaurus was a long-necked marine reptile that swam with four powerful flippers.

name: Dimetrodon
funFact: Dimetrodon lived before dinosaurs existed
description: Dimetrodon was a sail-backed synapsid predator that lived 40 million years before T. rex.

name: Woolly Rhino
funFact: Cave paintings show woolly rhinos
description: The woolly rhinoceros was a shaggy-coated rhino that roamed Ice Age Eurasia alongside mammoths.

name: Irish Elk
funFact: Irish elk antlers spanned 3.5 meters
description: Irish Elk was the largest deer ever, with enormous antlers that spanned over 3 meters.

name: Dire Wolf
funFact: Dire wolves were 30% heavier than gray wolves
description: Dire Wolf was a large Ice Age wolf that hunted in packs across North America.
